findings.explanation: The contract specifies that intellectual property and derivative works you create vest in the Client as a work made for hire upon creation, rather than transferring only upon full payment. This means the Client owns your work immediately regardless of payment status.
findings.suggested_change: Ownership of all intellectual property and derivative works created by the Contractor shall remain with the Contractor until all amounts due under this Agreement have been paid in full, at which point ownership shall transfer to the Client.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello, I hope you are well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose an adjustment before signing:

- Regarding the relevant clause, the current text means the client owns the work immediately regardless of payment status. I propose changing this so that ownership of all intellectual property and derivative works created by the contractor remains with the contractor until all amounts due under the agreement have been paid in full, at which point ownership shall transfer to the client.

Thank you for your time and understanding.
